Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl/fuzz/corpora/client && python3 -c "
import struct
data = open('071d0b50c4d22855408382821e0393f6bbfc457c','rb').read()
print('len:', len(data))
print('hex:', data.hex())
print()
i = 0
while i + 5 <= len(data):
    rtype = data[i]
    ver = data[i+1:i+3]
    length = struct.unpack('>H', data[i+3:i+5])[0]
    body = data[i+5:i+5+length]
    print(f'Record: type={rtype} ver={ver.hex()} len={length}')
    if rtype == 22:
        j = 0
        while j + 4 <= len(body):
            htype = body[j]
            hlen = struct.unpack('>I', b'\x00' + body[j+1:j+4])[0]
            hbody = body[j+4:j+4+hlen]
            print(f'  Handshake: type={htype} len={hlen}')
            if htype == 0x0c:
                plen = struct.unpack('>H', hbody[0:2])[0]
                p = hbody[2:2+plen]
                glen = struct.unpack('>H', hbody[2+plen:4+plen])[0]
                g = hbody[4+plen:4+plen+glen]
                klen = struct.unpack('>H', hbody[4+plen+glen:6+plen+glen])[0]
                k = hbody[6+plen+glen:6+plen+glen+klen]
                print(f'    DH: plen={plen} p={p.hex()} glen={glen} g={g.hex()} klen={klen} k={k.hex()}')
            j += 4 + hlen
    i += 5 + length
"
